name: stand_up
caption: 400 people tried to make this dog stand 🐕
logline: A young man logs back into his childhood server after ten years to find his old dirt hut, joins the town's queue to try to stand up the dog nobody can move, and remembers too late whose dog it is.
question: why tf is there a line of people trying to stand up a dog?
premise: In the middle of a big server town, a tamed wolf has sat on the same block for ten years, under a little roof the players built over it. Four hundred players have queued to try to make it stand; only a tamed dog's owner can. A kid called Pia runs the line. The narrator, back for the first time in ten years to find his first house (a dirt hut with a lime wool roof on the hill behind the dog), gets in line because the path up the hill goes right past it.
twist: It's his dog. At eight he tamed it, named it BESTFREND, dyed its collar lime (only an owner can), told it to sit at the foot of his hill, logged off and never came back. The town grew around the dog. When he clicks it, it stands up. 'I told him I'd be back tomorrow.'

N.name: me (Theo)
N.profile: a young man of eighteen, wry and a little too cool, telling a friend about going back to an old server; the cool cracks at the end
N.on_screen: player actor = recording bot, skin efe, seen from behind and side in camera shots; POV for the click

Pia.name: Pia, the kid who runs the line
Pia.profile: about ten, bossy and bright, proud of her job; blunt; her loud voice drops when she means something
Pia.on_screen: player actor 'Pia', skin sunny, standing on a barrel by the plot's gate; scale 0.75 if the renderer supports the vanilla scale attribute

Bestfrend.name: the dog
Bestfrend.profile: never makes a sound until he stands (a single vanilla wolf bark/whine is allowed)
Bestfrend.on_screen: tamed wolf, sitting, lime collar, name tag BESTFREND

requests.direction: A busy town square on an old Minecraft server. A young man tells a friend about going back after ten years; a bossy ten-year-old girl runs a queue.

lines.text: FOUR HUNDRED players / have tried / to make / this dog / STAND UP.
lines.say: <short pause> Four hundred players have tried to make this dog stand up.
lines.direction: hushed disbelief; a small breath before the number

lines.text: He's been SITTING / on that block / for TEN YEARS.
A CREEPER / took out / the house / next to him. / He didn't MOVE.
lines.say: A creeper took out the house next to him. <short pause> He didn't move.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact, then a beat of respect

lines.text: People tried / STEAK. / BONES. / A whole BAND.
lines.say: People tried steak. Bones. <short pause> A whole band.
lines.direction: dry comic timing, a list that gets sillier

lines.text: Only his OWNER / can make / him stand. / NEXT!
lines.say: Only his owner can make him stand. <short pause> NEXT!
lines.direction: a tour guide who has said it a thousand times, sing-song; the last word shouted

lines.text: I hadn't / logged in here / in TEN years. / I came back / to find / my first HOUSE.
A DIRT HUT / on that hill. / LIME wool roof. / I was EIGHT.
lines.say: A dirt hut on that hill. Lime wool roof. <short pause> I was eight.
lines.direction: fond and a bit embarrassed by his younger self

lines.text: The dog's / name tag / says BESTFREND. / Some kid / couldn't SPELL.
lines.say: The dog's name tag says... Bestfrend. <short pause> Some kid couldn't spell.

lines.text: Somebody / told him SIT. / And never / came BACK.
lines.say: Somebody told him sit. <short pause> And never came back.
lines.direction: suddenly quiet and serious, a kid stating something unfair

lines.text: The path / up the hill / goes right / past him. / So I got / in LINE.
When it was / my TURN, / I almost / didn't BOTHER.
lines.say: When it was my turn... I almost didn't bother.
lines.direction: slower, the cool starting to slip; a held breath at the end
barely above a whisper, to him, not the dog; the bossiness gone

lines.text: I told him / I'd be back / TOMORROW.
lines.say: I told him... I'd be back tomorrow.
lines.direction: holding it together and only just; a catch before the last word

beats_without_lines.what: The click. POV: the crosshair on the dog, the hand swings, and the dog stands up (vanilla: only the owner's interaction toggles sit). Cut to a WS from behind Pia: the dog up on four legs for the first time in ten years, the queue turning, someone drops a steak. One vanilla wolf whine.
